name: Shankar's letter
description: Blue inland letter written by Shankar before his death, addressed to Kamla and Arjun, marked 'open when Meera is home'.

name: Kamla's tin box
description: Dented tin box where Kamla keeps family papers; the letter should have been inside.

name: Meera's suitcase
description: Worn blue suitcase Meera arrives with.

name: Bansi's post bicycle
description: Old black bicycle with a khaki mail bag on the carrier.

name: Shankar's photograph
description: Garlanded framed photograph of Shankar in the courtyard.

name: Brass lantern
description: Brass hurricane lantern hanging by the courtyard door; shatters during the confrontation.

name: Money-order slips
description: Monthly money-order slips from Delhi, always received in Raghav's name.

name: Raghav's ledger
description: Shop ledger with loan-repayment entries hidden among cloth accounts.

name: Registered letter from Delhi
description: Registered-post envelope addressed to Meera in unfamiliar handwriting; the episode's cliffhanger.
